excerpts.title: Signing a one-tap answer
excerpts.why: Each Lock Screen button is HMAC-signed over job, prompt, index and label, so a relay that rewrites a label breaks the signature.
text: // ChoiceSig authenticates one one-tap answer as the machine published it. The Lock Screen shows answers

// Fields are length-prefixed so no two different choices hash alike.

excerpts.title: Is a line prompt still asking?
excerpts.why: A [y/N] prompt counts as waiting only while the cursor is still on it, so an answered question does not keep asking.
